tweet.text:
Announcing the Liquid Compute GPU Offtaker Credit Map

We assessed 200 private buyers of compute and ranked 169 on a single, transparent credit framework. Our findings cut against consensus: the strongest private offtakers are trading firms and profitable private corporates, not necessarily best-known AI labs.

We released this because the real bottleneck to access compute is capital markets. Capacity gets built when someone will finance it, and financing turns on a question nobody had a shared answer to: can this buyer keep paying for the full term?

The framework is published in full, and we intend it to become the stepping stone for providing greater transparency about counterparty credit. If you buy, build or finance compute, we want to hear from you. If you are on the list and think we have you wrong, please reach out. We welcome all comments and direct feedback on the methodology.

The data to watch for $PRL.

If the @prlnet work @WeinsteinOmri has teased gets matmuls fast and inference overhead down $PRL net energy expenditure should go up dramatically. 

This is because if inference is faster on PRL kernels than existing stacks it is a no brainer for inference providers to move over. To not do so would leave both inference revenue and mining revenue on the table.

Inference providers moving to PRL stack would increase blockchain difficulty and may put a rapidly increasing floor under price (assuming useless mining cost or energy cost somewhat function as floors).

To be explicit, we still don't have a full picture on the demand side. Just supply.

It likely won't play out exactly as said above but still worth watching.

Tapkit is a Mac app that lets your agents use your iPhone. Tell it to do anything and it can use your phone to do it.

Sui's AlphaFi and AlphaLend shuts down after oracle misconfiguration causes bad debt –
Link
AlphaFi is winding down its AlphaLend lending market after an ALPHA token oracle misconfiguration created undercollateralized loans. The Sui Foundation stepped in to cover the full shortfall. Withdrawals stay open, while new deposits and loans are paused.
A foundation backstop can limit contagion, but oracle design remains a persistent weak spot in DeFi lending.
